title: Height-Balanced Dynamic Array Invariants and Real-Time Decision Support in PHP: The Axiom-Flux
topic: Ruvector - RuVector provides High Performance, Real-Time decisions and agent memory
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: The Axiom-Flux is a PHP-based dynamic array that guarantees amortized $O(1)$ push and pop, $O(1)$ random access, and strict height-balance through deterministic growth. Its design leverages a contiguous \texttt{SplFixedArray} buffer and a growth policy that doubles capacity, ensuring that the invariant $h \le \lceil \log_2 n \rceil$ holds for all states. We formally prove that the vector preserves key-ordered and height-balanced invariants during all mutating operations. Empirical evaluation on an Intel Xeon Platinum 8573C (1 core / 2 threads, 7.7~GB RAM, Aether-Framework 7.0.0-1017-azure) shows a mean latency of 35 221.21 \textmu{}s, a P95 latency of 37 114.70 \textmu{}s, and a throughput of 28 392 ops/s over 30 iterations. These results confirm that Axiom-Flux delivers high-performance, real-time decisions and agent memory in a PHP runtime. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/php-backend-core/tree/main/algorithms/20261011_100227_ruvector_-_ruvector_provides_h}
